description: Load this skill when planning a software project into SKELETON.md and ITER_NN.md files, one release at a time or the complete build to a working MVP in one session. Next-release mode (the default) writes one scoped artifact. Whole-build mode plans the skeleton plus every iteration upfront, behind a complexity gate. Trigger on "plan the next feature", "create a skeleton plan", "plan this whole app to MVP". Not for building the plan (use implement-from-plan) or a small non-feature change to a built version (use apply-small-fix-to-version).
